title: Wasago RP
description: Resource pack with totems and special items that wasago uses. It uses renames of totems of undying. It includes youtuber's totems and special items from WasagoSMP server.
body:
Wasago SMP texture pack. Can be usable for fans or other stuff. Contains players totem textures and other special server stuff.
# What does this add?
- Nukvin's, fulfigo's, PolimerS_ and a lot more totems of undying!
- Special items from WasagoSMP server, such as metro icon, etc.
# How to use it?
- Install CITResewn mod.
- Move downloaded .zip file to resource pack folder.
- Enjoy! 
# Why should you use it?
- Well, maybe you want to take a part in some youtuber's life? Maybe you are a fan of somebody? Go on!
